items.a: CPGRAMS (Centralized Public Grievance Redress and Monitoring System) is an online platform for citizens to lodge grievances against public authorities on service delivery matters, available 24x7.

items.q: How do I file a grievance?
items.a: Register or log in, click 'Public Grievance', accept the terms, select the concerned department and jurisdiction, describe your grievance, attach any supporting documents, and submit.
Grievances are generally addressed within 30 days. Complex cases may take longer, and you will be notified of any delays.
If you are not satisfied with the resolution of a closed grievance, you may file an appeal for further review by a higher authority.

items.q: How do I track my grievance?
items.a: Use the 'Check Status' page with your registration ID and registered email, or view 'My Grievances' after logging in.

items.q: Can I file a grievance anonymously?
items.a: No. To ensure accountability and enable follow-up, grievances require a registered account with valid contact details.
